commons.title: Mapofdarvaz.png
commons.description: Map of the Pamiri Principality of Darvaz that existed until 1878. Sources include " Identity, History and Trans-Nationality in Central Asia: The Mountain Communities of Pamir" (pages 123-142), The encyclopedia Iranica article on Darvaz [1], and History of civilizations of Central Asia, v. 5: Development in contrast, from the sixteenth to the mid-nineteenth century (pages 226-229).
commons.editorial_reason: The image is a historical map of Darvaz, not visible Shughni cultural dress, architecture, craft, music, dance, or objects.
